propositions: sign_manifest emits no warning when it signs a manifest under a key whose public counterpart is unresolvable by the verify-side resolver, allowing silently uncertifiable attestations to be minted
the startup/deploy health surface does not check whether the bound signer's public key matches the pinned trusted-environment key, missing a non-redundant environment-binding validation

the mint-time guard must warn (naming key path and principal) when _read_opcert_pub(key_path) body is not in _opcert_own_public_keys, even if a different chain key's pub resolves, but must still return the signature
the startup health check must report a degraded opcert field and log a boot warning when the bound signer's public key does not match rebar.attest.trusted_env, but never abort boot

existing verify-side resolver (_opcert_own_public_keys) has exactly one caller (verify_opcert_record) and is never invoked during the mint path (mint_opcert_record → ensure_opcert_key), confirming the guard is absent
the fix must be additive and non-refusing, preserving all existing success paths and returned signatures
